digest.component_or_area: store: git contention handling (local index and ref locks)
propositions: rebar local git call sites contend on .git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock without automatic retry or bounded backoff, surfacing lock errors to the agent instead of absorbing transient contention
transient index/ref lock conflicts held briefly by concurrent processes cause cascading failures because rebar holds the store write lock while calling git, stalling all other agents
local-only git call sites in compact, delete, fsck, txn, event_append, metrics are unbounded with no watchdog, risking indefinite stalls on hung mounts or stuck peer locks
per-store advisory flock plus bounded jittered retry on git lock signatures (consistent with push retry pattern) serializes rebar writers and self-heals transient conflicts silently

watchdog timeouts on local git subprocesses (120s for plumbing, 300s for slow operations like blame/log walks) distinguish wedged filesystem from slow work while protecting the store write lock from cascading stall
